## About
PURE Motorsport is a full service independent Audi and VW specialist in the heart of Miramar, San Diego. Our factory trained technicians use current tools and diagnostic equipment, including factory ODIS and VAG-COM (VCDS), to find the problem and fix it right.
As an independent repair facility, our prices are typically lower than what local dealerships charge. We stick closely to manufacturer recommended service intervals, and we work with the local dealerships when something may be covered under the manufacturer's warranty. Consider us your dealership alternative.
We also stock performance parts. We carry APR and AWE Tuning, and we are warehouse distributors for companies like KONI, Eibach, Bilstein, Vogtland, Neuspeed, HRE Wheels and Brembo.

## Services
- Check Engine Lights (CEL): We read the codes and trace the fault behind a check engine light.
- Factory ODIS Diagnostics: Diagnostics with the factory ODIS system used for Audi and VW.
- VAG-COM (VCDS) Services: Scanning, coding and adjustments with VAG-COM (VCDS).
- Factory Recommended Scheduled Service: Scheduled maintenance at the intervals the factory recommends.
- Timing Belt Service: Timing belt replacement for the engines that use one.
- DSG Transmission Flush: Fluid service for DSG transmissions.
- Haldex Differential Service: Service for the Haldex all-wheel-drive differential.
- Alignments / Corner balancing: Wheel alignments and corner balancing.

## FAQ
Q: Which cars do you work on?
A: We specialize in Audi and Volkswagen, and we also service Porsche.

Q: Do you follow the factory service intervals?
A: Yes. We stick closely with all manufacturer recommended service intervals.

Q: Is your work under warranty?
A: Yes. We back all our work with our own shop warranty.

Q: Can I wait while you diagnose a problem?
A: Often, yes. Give us a call or stop in, and we can usually diagnose problems quickly while you wait.

Q: Do you sell performance parts?
A: Yes. We carry APR and AWE Tuning, and we are warehouse distributors for brands such as KONI, Eibach, Bilstein and Brembo.
